verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair axis for an auth service and its ecosystem, but the evidence pack never documents a Supabase CLI. The only command-line hint is a `-y` non-interactive flag in the self-hosting Docker guide. That flag belongs to a setup step, not an official CLI for AI-native workflows, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
